title: Word Practice — ESL Pronunciation Coach
description: A production-ready, browser-native ESL pronunciation coach with 80 curated words across four sound groups, slow text-to-speech playback, and instant microphone feedback.

highlights: Native SpeechRecognition pronunciation check with heard-text feedback
Light and dark themes with localStorage persistence
Keyboard shortcuts and accessible tab/word navigation
No build step, no dependencies, no tracking
credits: Built with OpenCode and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash.
